name: Chōnan (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Chōnan town emblem in yellow and white: a yellow ring enclosing a white stylised character on a yellow bar.
history: Municipal flag of Chōnan, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 June 1970.

features.role: Chōnan town emblem — a yellow ring enclosing a white stylised character on a yellow bar
